files.annotations.jsonl: classification_v2_ocr rows of aidpbench-aidp-v1-main-pipeline, one per corpus file (main file or attachment), joined by doc_bytes_hash = sha256 of the file's bytes; 2008 of 2012 files have a stored reading; 0 stored rows match no corpus file
files.stability-submissions.jsonl: one row per submission of the repeatability run (600): every extraction run (status, duplicate flag, time), the matching engine's latest computation for it (v2_match_runs: status, duplicate_invoice exceptions) and what the matching index compared (number, seller, type)
files.main-pipeline-submissions.jsonl: the same for every document of the main run's full lane (2000)
files.main-prompt-submissions.jsonl: the same for every document of the main run's text lane (2000)
files.classification-runs.jsonl: every classification run of the main and repeatability runs, with its duplicate column, cache hit and category
